name: upload-post
description: Official Upload-Post marketplace: the Upload-Post plugin for publishing, scheduling, repurposing and analysing social media posts from Claude Code via the hosted Upload-Post MCP server.

plugins.name: upload-post
plugins.description: Publish and schedule videos, photos, carousels, text and documents to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Threads, Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky and more through the hosted Upload-Post MCP server (OAuth, no API key to copy). Includes skills for campaigns, posting queue, video repurposing, comments, AutoDMs and analytics, plus three subagents.
